Task complete. Summary:

- Wrote `out/T4/solution.py`: loads the sharded base checkpoint and the single-file ft1/ft2 checkpoints, verifies all three share the same 114 tensor names, identifies the 48 MLP tensors (`gate_proj`/`up_proj`/`down_proj` for layers 0–15), and asserts every non-MLP tensor is bit-identical across all three checkpoints (failing loudly otherwise — this enforces the frozen-backbone precondition).
- Computed `out[X] = base[X] + 0.4*(ft1[X]-base[X]) + 0.4*(ft2[X]-base[X])` in float32 for the 48 MLP tensors (each side computed against the unmodified base, avoiding the ordering hazard), copied the remaining 66 tensors unchanged from base, and asserted the merged count (48) and final tensor count (114) before writing.
- Ran it once with `.venv/bin/python out/T4/solution.py` — succeeded on the first attempt, wrote `out/T4/model.safetensors` with 114 tensors.
- Spot-checked the output file (114 keys, correct shape/dtype on a sample MLP tensor).
- Wrote `out/T4/REPORT.md` with the participant self-report.
